title: Mathematics Basics
description: Essential mathematical concepts spanning exponents, probability, basic geometry, and algebraic equations.
seoTitle: Mathematics Basics Quiz – Geometry, Algebra & Probability | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: 10 fundamental mathematics questions to evaluate your algebra, geometry, and probability skills.

questions.question: What is the mathematical constant Pi (π) commonly approximated to two decimal places?
questions.explanation: Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter, approximately equal to 3.14159...

questions.question: What is the probability of rolling an even number on a standard fair six-sided die?
questions.explanation: There are 3 even outcomes (2, 4, 6) out of 6 possible faces, giving a probability of 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.question: In a right-angled triangle, the Pythagorean Theorem states that a² + b² equals what?
questions.explanation: The sum of the squares of the two legs equals the square of the hypotenuse: a² + b² = c².

questions.question: What is 2 raised to the power of 8 (2⁸)?
What is the median of the following set of numbers: [3, 7, 9, 15, 21]?
questions.explanation: The median is the middle value of an ordered list. With 5 numbers, the 3rd number is 9.

questions.question: What is the slope (m) of a horizontal line on a Cartesian coordinate plane?
questions.explanation: A horizontal line has zero vertical change (rise = 0), so slope = rise / run = 0.

questions.question: What is the formula for the area of a circle with radius r?
questions.explanation: Area of a circle = πr², whereas the circumference is 2πr.

questions.question: What is the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 36 and 48?
questions.explanation: Factors of 36 include 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36. Factors of 48 include 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 48. The greatest common factor is 12.

questions.question: If a right triangle has legs of lengths 3 and 4, what is the length of its hypotenuse?
What is any non-zero real number raised to the power of 0 equal to?
questions.explanation: By definition of exponents, any non-zero base raised to the power of zero equals 1 (e.g., x⁰ = x¹⁻¹ = x¹/x¹ = 1).
